_comment: Wildreach sound table (WRSound.h has the event names; files are .ogg under Data/Audio, names without the extension). volume: 0..4 (the loudness match is already in it), pitch: [min, max], radius: cm (0 = 2D), category: effects / ui / ambient / music, minGap: seconds before the same event plays again on the same actor or spot, maxVoices: at once, duck: how far music dips under it. creatures: voice family and pitch per creature id. ambient: beds crossfaded by layer (volcanic, tundra, coast, day, night, volcanic.day/night, tundra.day/night, cave, lava, high, wind, always). music: pools (menu, explore, night, combat, boss) and timings in seconds. Rebuilt from the sources by Tools/audio (see Docs/CREDITS.md). Storm peaks adds layers storm_peaks / storm_peaks.day / storm_peaks.night / storm.<zone> (passes, cliffs, bridges, crags, shrines, rodfield, hollow) / weather.thunderstorm.storm_peaks, and pools explore/night/combat/mini/camp.storm_peaks, boss.kharvox, sub.monastery, sub.hollow_spire, layer.great_storm, pass.stormgut (Tools/audio/build_storm_audio.py). The Swamp adds layers swamp / swamp.day / swamp.night / swamp.<zone> (reeds, reeds.night, mangroves, boardwalks, pools, pools.night, bones) / swamp.falls / swamp.bleedwater / swamp.red_tide / swamp.coven, creature kinds tell and signature (creature.<family>.tell / .signature), and pools explore.swamp.a/b/c, night/combat/mini/camp.swamp, boss.mother_maw, boss.hex_warden, boss.bloat, boss.vharra.p1-p3, sub.sunken_coven, layer.red_tide (Tools/audio/build_swamp_audio.py).

events._combatFull: cooks/build-combat-full.md: the final cue before a held strike (a bright ring), element reactions, a part breaking, the ground heaving before a burst, each status's proc. Built from the files already in Data/Audio (CREDITS.md).
events._survival: cooks/build-survival.md: lying down, waking Rested, a torch or lantern lit, put out and doused, a lightning strike's crackling warning and its crack. Built from the files already in Data/Audio (CREDITS.md).

salvage._note: gear broken down at a station: a lighter, higher clatter of the demolish set

socket.remove._note: an extra pried out of a socket

blueprint.learn._note: a blueprint read: its recipe is yours

events._hitLayers: A landed blow plays four layers (WRFxCombat.cpp, COMBAT-AND-LESSONS L1): hit.transient.<flesh|armor|stone> (the edge), hit.body.<light|heavy> (the weight; the heavy one ducks the music ~2 dB), the material (hit.flesh / hit.armor / hit.dust / frost.impact by what was hit, fx.json impacts) and the creature's hurt voice. Crits add crit.stab (4 dB duck), breaks stance.break / guard.break. Files from Tools/audio/make_combat_layers.py.

chest.open._note: a swamp cache's lid thrown back (WRSwampSystems)

mire.murkjaw_bellow._note: The water shivering over a Murkjaw's bellow (material layer; the bellow itself is creature.murkjaw.signature).

mire.burst._note: A Murkjaw out of the duckweed in a sheet of spray.

mire.roll_thrash._note: The death roll's churn (it ticks while the roll holds).

mire.leech_click._note: The wet click of the three jaws opening (with creature.gorgeleech.signature, the Y-click).

mire.leech_pop._note: A leech torn off a body (wet pop).

mire.curse_caw._note: The hackles and wings flaring under the curse cry (the caw is creature.hexcrow.signature; several crows make the chorus).

mire.murder_call._note: A Hexcrow calling the murder (carries 60 m and more).

mire.throat_pump._note: The Bogstalker's throat sac pumping (the tongue's wind-up).

mire.tongue_crack._note: The wet crack of the tongue going out (with creature.bogstalker.signature).

mire.flop_land._note: A bull-sized frog coming down in mud and water.

mire.spit._note: A glob of mud spat (and a survivor spat out of a mouth).

mire.bill_stab._note: A Mirestrider's bill stabbing a fish out of the shallows.

mire.clatter._note: Bill knocking (material layer under creature.mirestrider.signature, the machine-gun clatter).

mire.hulk_yawn._note: The water churned by a Mudhulk's yawn (the groan is creature.mudhulk.signature).

mire.surge._note: A Mudhulk heaving up out of the water under you.

mire.toad_swell._note: The soft glass hum of the sac brightening.

mire.toad_pouch._note: A tame Lanterntoad settling into its owner's shoulder pouch.

mire.shell_clack._note: Slime stretching as the foot pulls in (the shell's clack is creature.slimeshell.signature).

mire.snout_find._note: A tame Bogsnout's snuffle-grunt over something it rooted out.

mire.rite._note: The wrist opened over a Murkjaw's jaws (the blood rite begins).

mire.rite_done._note: The Murkjaw drinks and goes under.
